WPFOptimizeMyPC.Description: Deletes temporary files, runs Disk Cleanup and removes old Windows Update files. Shows how much space was freed when it finishes.

WPFStartupApps.Description: Shows every app that opens when Windows starts. Untick the ones you don't need for a faster boot. Nothing is uninstalled.

WPFGamingMode.Description: Switches to the High Performance power plan, turns on Game Mode and turns off Xbox Game Bar and background recording. Undo: pick Balanced in Settings > System > Power.

WPFDriverUpdates.Description: Checks Windows Update for new drivers and asks before installing them, then opens NVIDIA App and Intel Driver & Support Assistant if you have them.

WPFFixClock.Description: Pick your time zone from a list, then Windows sets it and syncs the clock with internet time.

WPFFixInternet.Description: Clears the DNS cache and resets Windows network settings, for when sites won't load or the connection acts weird. Needs a restart.

WPFFeaturesdotnet.Description: .NET and .NET Framework is a developer platform made up of tools, programming languages, and libraries for building many different types of applications.

WPFFeatureshyperv.Description: Hyper-V is a hardware virtualization product developed by Microsoft that allows users to create and manage virtual machines.

WPFFeaturewsl.Description: Windows Subsystem for Linux is an optional feature of Windows that allows Linux programs to run natively on Windows without the need for a separate virtual machine or dual booting.

WPFFeaturesSandbox.Description: Windows Sandbox is a lightweight virtual machine that provides a temporary desktop environment to safely run applications and programs in isolation.

WPFMyPCInfo.Description: Shows your PC name, Windows edition and activation, CPU, GPU, RAM, free space on each drive and how long since the last restart.

WPFWhatsRunning.Description: Shows which apps are using the most memory and CPU right now, and which apps start with Windows.

WPFDiskHealth.Description: Shows whether your SSDs and hard drives are healthy: life left, temperature, hours used and errors. Warns you before a drive fails.

WPFTemperatures.Description: Shows how hot your graphics card and drives are, with the GPU's load, fan and how far it is from slowing itself down. Warns when something runs hot.

WPFPingTest.Description: Measures ping, jitter and packet loss to your router and to Cloudflare, Google and Quad9, and tells you whether lag comes from your Wi-Fi or your internet provider.

WPFApplyDNS.Description: Switches to the DNS provider picked in the box above. Cloudflare is usually the fastest.

WPFAutoClean.Description: Every Sunday at 12:00 Windows quietly deletes temp files and old Windows Update files. Click again to turn it off.

WPFCreateRestorePoint.Description: Saves a snapshot of Windows settings and system files you can go back to if something breaks.

WPFSystemRestore.Content: Go Back to a Restore Point
WPFSystemRestore.Description: Opens Windows System Restore to pick a restore point to go back to. Your personal files are not touched.

WPFPanelUpdates.Description: Pause updates or choose security updates only.

WPFBackupApps.Description: Saves a list of your installed apps to a file. Use Restore Apps on a new PC or after reinstalling Windows to get them all back.

WPFRestoreApps.Description: Installs every app listed in a backup file made with Backup My Apps.

WPFRenamePC.Description: Changes the PC's name (now a random one like DESKTOP-JS4RJ0B) to one you choose. Needs a restart.

WPFRemoteDesktop.Description: Lets you control this PC from another device with the Windows App: turns on Remote Desktop, opens it in the firewall, allows password sign-in, and shows the address to connect to. Click again to turn it off. Home can't be controlled this way; use Parsec there.

WPFBackupDrivers.Description: Saves every driver installed on this PC (Wi-Fi, audio, chipset, GPU...) to a folder. After a Windows reinstall, Restore Drivers puts them all back at once. Can be a few GB, mostly the graphics driver.

WPFRestoreDrivers.Description: Installs every driver from a folder made by Backup Drivers.

WPFShowChanges.Description: Lists every setting Optimize has changed on this PC, grouped by tweak, and marks any that a Windows update has changed back. The list is kept in C:\ProgramData\Optimize\changes.json.

WPFReapplyChanges.Description: Windows updates sometimes put settings back. This sets every Optimize change that was changed back again, using the values Optimize saved.

WPFUndoAllChanges.Description: Puts every setting Optimize changed back to what this PC had before, not just Windows' defaults. Removed apps are not reinstalled. Needs a restart.
